subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles deals with the composition of the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 80**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 80 of the Indian Constitution deals with the composition of the Council of States, which is commonly known as the Rajya Sabha.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
• As per Article 80, the Rajya Sabha consists of not more than 250 members.
 
• Out of these, 12 members are nominated by the President of India from among persons having special knowledge or practical experience in fields such as literature, science, art, and social service, and the remaining members are representatives of the States and Union territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 76**

 
 
• Article 76 of the Indian Constitution deals with the office of the Attorney General of India.
 
• The Attorney General is the chief legal advisor to the Government of India and has the right to participate in the proceedings of both Houses of Parliament, but without a right to vote.
 
 
 
• **Article 84**
 
 
• Article 84 of the Indian Constitution specifies the qualifications required to be a member of Parliament.
 
• These qualifications include being a citizen of India, being not less than 30 years of age in the case of the Rajya Sabha and 25 years in the case of the Lok Sabha, and possessing such other qualifications as may be prescribed by law by the Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Article 92**
 
 
• Article 92 of the Indian Constitution deals with the provisions for the Chairman or Deputy Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).
 
• It states that while the office of Chairman or Deputy Chairman is vacant, or in the absence of the Chairman from any sitting of the Council, the duties of the office shall be performed by the Deputy Chairman, or if the Deputy Chairman is also absent, by such member of the Council as may be determined by the rules of procedure of the Council.
